info.title: Provider API
info.description: API for integrating telehealth and in-person provider consultations — speciality discovery, provider search, appointment booking, document management, and video consultations. All requests must include a valid `ls-api-key` header.

ApiKeyAuth.name: ls-api-key
ApiKeyAuth.description: API key issued by LabStack. Pass this in every request header.

400.description: Invalid request — bad appointmentId, empty/oversized documents array, unsupported file extension or size, or an invalid docType (including PRESCRIPTION, which is provider-only).

docType.description: PRIOR_PRESCRIPTION for a prescription the patient already had, REFERRAL for a referral letter, OTHER for anything else. PRESCRIPTION is provider-only and returns 400.

get.description: Cancels an appointment for the store; enforces the provider's cancellation cutoff window when the provider's main store differs. This GET has side effects.

followUpDays.description: Free follow-up window (days) starting from this appointment; null if not configured or this booking is itself a follow-up

paymentLink.description: Only returned when isPaymentRequired is true. Valid for 15 minutes from booking.

paymentLinkExpiresAt.description: Only returned when isPaymentRequired is true. Always 15 minutes after booking; the appointment is cancelled at this point if unpaid.

isPaymentRequired.description: Optional. If true a payment link valid for 15 minutes is returned, and the appointment is auto-cancelled (releasing the slot) if it is not paid within that window. Defaults to false.

paymentAmount.description: Optional. Amount (in INR) the customer is asked to pay, used only when isPaymentRequired is true. Must be greater than 0, have at most 2 decimal places, and must not exceed the configured cost of the procedure on the booked slot. Omit to charge that configured cost. Not supported for provider-group requests, which have no confirmed slot.

post.description: Creates an appointment (ONLINE teleconsult, HOME_VISIT, or CENTER_VISIT) with a provider or provider group for the authenticated store. Provide either lsProviderId or lsGroupId, and either dateOfBirth or age. Supports follow-up bookings and an optional pre-appointment payment link, which defaults to the configured cost of the procedure unless a lower paymentAmount is supplied. That link is valid for 15 minutes and the appointment is auto-cancelled if payment is not completed in that window.

get.description: Returns the store's LabStack wallet balance (currently a stub returning 0).
